One EMI bounced: how much does it really cost you?

Illustrative: when an EMI auto-debit fails, the lender adds a bounce charge (₹500 here, plus taxes).
Your own bank can charge a separate fee for the failed auto-debit (₹500 here).
One bounce: ₹1,000+, before any late-payment charges on the EMI itself.
Amounts vary: check your loan's key fact statement and your bank's schedule of charges.

Has an auto-debit ever failed on you?
Send this to the friend whose salary lands after EMI day.

Sources: two lending companies' guides to EMI bounce charges; a bank's blog on personal-loan EMI bounces. Illustrative amounts only.
